name: Standing Calf Stretch
steps: Stand facing a wall at arm's length, plant both palms flat against the wall at chest height, and step one foot straight back behind you.
Keep your back leg completely straight with the heel pressed flat into the floor and both feet pointing straight toward the wall.
Bend your front knee and shift your hips toward the wall until you feel a gentle stretch in the rear calf.
Hold the stretch steadily with calm breathing on one side, then step forward and switch legs.
tips: Keep your rear heel anchored down on the floor rather than letting it lift as you lean in.
Point your back toes directly ahead so the calf stretches evenly.
